name: Yellowstone County, MT
findings: Yellowstone County has 564 nonprofit organizations. 231 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 196 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Yellowstone County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 34 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 34 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Research and think tank organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 8 research and think tank organizations here list membership, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.
